DefaultDialogue: If you're not Marauder, you're nothing.
We need more 'real' warriors around here.
We need more 'real' warriors around here. This is the battle that counts.\n[ Level 58 required for Shattered Mountain faction missions ]
Simple minds will find little traction communicating with the enlightened.
Ah, I have your name whispered in quiet places.
Ah, I have your name whispered in quiet places. You see the truth, and where you not see it, you search.\n[ Level 58 required for Shattered Mountain faction missions ]
The Spark requires fuel for its sustenance.
Watch yourself in Shattered Mountain, my courageous colleague.
Watch yourself in Shattered Mountain, my courageous colleague.
From far away, the Shattered Mountain looks rather intimidating.
Perhaps there's hope for us yet, eh? Not that I was actually starting to lose hope, mind you.
Well now, imagine seeing you here, {playerName}. I had a feeling you joined the Soulwardens.
You know what I keep asking myself? How exactly did I wind up here?
You know... I just remembered a legend about a 'Baetylus Headpiece'…
There must be some way we can put these Baetylus Luckstones to work?
Always good to see another regular old human being here in the outpost.
<g id="female_thinking" />Well, I don't know - I thought we were doing quite well against the Corrupted,<g id="male_checkbehind" priority="high" /> but… then we weren't.
<g id="male_smallSingleWave" />Look here, it's my old friend, {playerName}. <g id="male_salute2FingersFast" />I wondered if you had joined the Soulwardens.
<g id="female_notsure" />Honestly, I don't know if I'll be able to bring myself to eat it. <g id="male_spreadhands" />I mean, gator?
No word from Clarion in some time.
The fact is simply that the Corrupted grow in strength and numbers by the hour.
So you managed to knock the Corruption off-balance around this hellish place…
If the Tempest is gone, then these infernal Corrupted will have to let up at some point.
At this point, I've been watching for Corruption or fighting against it as long as I can remember.
If I was a woman of faith, I'd say you were sent straight from the heavens.
Aye, you've crossed my mind more than once, {playerName}. That day back in First Light seems a lifetime ago.
It was no small thing dealing with those vicars and that loathsome ritual.
I must confess - even I am beginning to feel hopeless in the face of such evil.
For too long we have been able to do little while Corruption spreads down from the mountain.
If it isn't my friend {playerName} from the beach in Windsward. Long ago, that seems now.
Your presence here is more than an inspiration, my friend.
Welcome to Shattered Mountain, Warden.
How splendid, another intrepid adventurer out in the wilds!
If we can harness the putrescent horror of the Blight to fight the Corrupted, we can win this.
There... is another idea that forced itself into my mind.
Somehow,<g id="female_thinking" /> some way, we must find a path that leads inside the Mountain itself.
<g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />You have done all that you can and more for us here in the outpost, Warden.
I'm beginning to have doubts about our position here.
In my time on Aeternum, I've seen darkness to terrify anyone in the Old World.
The Corrupted have found a way to use Ancient forging techniques to craft new weapons.
Did you know the Corrupted have their own language? I don't have enough samples to translate it yet.
I've walked these lands for as long as I can remember.
Mind yourself if you leave the outpost.
Shattered Mountain is hardly a comfortable place, but we do what we can. Welcome to the 'Last Beacon', friend. Make yourself at home.
This maybe an outpost on the front lines, but I tolerate no messiness, understand? You're welcome to the 'Riven Shield', but clean up after yourself.
There are still battles to be had for the resources of this land. Are you interested?
<g id="male_think" />The ropes… bound tight… <g id="male_spreadhands" />What do they bind? What do they hold?
<g id="female_leanforwardListensound" />The screams… they sing like a choir… <g id="male_nodProud" />a lovely chorus of suffering...
<g id="female_lookConcern" />I am lost in the dark... I cannot find my way… <g id="female_drawbackAfraid" />Is this hell…?

<g id="female_clenchfistsSuffer" />She abandoned me in the dark, she never loved me, my love turns to dust in my hands, bile in my mouth. Something approaches, something calls to me. <g id="female_handsforwardRequest" />Dear God, save my soul…
<g id="female_thinking" />I am curious about this 'Tempest', <g id="female_notsure" />or should I call her Isabella?

<g id="female_bowDeep" />I am Mara Rosa. <g id="female_touchhands" />I have managed to make my way to Aeternum and to this broken mountain in search of knowledge. <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />But I dare not enter this unholy place.
<g id="male_spreadhands" />What of Isabella's family? <g id="male_patience" />The name of de Leon was once respected by the people of Spain.

<g id="male_explain" />The documents across the island speak of a man with no name, but a chilling title: <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" />The Heretic. He was at Isabella's side from the journey's start.
<g id="female_thinking" />Now that we know Isabella willingly embraced Corruption, I am curious if any of her humanity remained.
<g id="male_clenchfistsAngry" />It must have been this Heretic who polluted her mind and forced her to commit such atrocities.
<g id="female_thinking" />There was a priest who travelled with Isabella. He sought to save her from the Heretic. <g id="female_crossarms" />His name was Father Russo.
<g id="female_disagreeCrossarms" />Everything we have learned has revealed a great truth: those who were meant to protect Isabella all failed her. <g id="female_lookdownSorry" />Including me.
A collection of pages about Isabella de Leon.
<g id="male_nodProud" />I have seen mysteries far beyond your ken {playerName}.
<g id="female_leanforwardListen" />So you come seeking the lost?\n<g id="male_explain" />When the mind is unbound, there are no limits to its sight.
<g id="female_saluteFistchest" />We need to band together in these dark times. Armor, teamwork, strategy… <g id="male_spreadhands" />we need to use everything we have.
<g id="male_explain" />Found three damaged wagons this week. One had weapons, the other food, the third crafting equipment.
<g id="female_salute2finger" />I heard you defeated the Corrupted within their strongholds. <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />Is any loot left for the picking?
<g id="male_explain" />The longer the bow, the stronger it is. The stronger the bow, <g id="female_crossarms" />the faster and farther your arrow goes.
<g id="male_explain" />Hardwoods are good for making recurve bows. <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />You'll want to equip one of Qasim's if you're facing the Corrupted camps here.
<g id="female_cheerFisthigh" />Well done against the Corrupted! I was helping you from the shadows. <g id="male_nodProud" />You may have seen one of my arrows fly by.
<g id="male_dontknowS" />I don't understand war against humans. But war against the Corrupted? <g id="female_nodConsider" />That I do understand.
